entries.note: Two sealed geodesic grow domes lit violet inside over ring beds, joined by a pressurised tube. Covered farm on a hostile world; walk-in, no cover.
One lit geodesic grow dome with a south airlock, to end a row or fill a short plot.
Tank station: two water and nutrient tanks on a skid with a pipe, ending a dome row.

note: A covered farm look for hostile worlds (story-map-pools.md, Planet skin; PlanetSkin.FarmLook), one of three put to the owner after the polytunnels did not read as hydroponics. Measured 1448x1086 RGBA, three alpha pieces. Geometry-first reskin of templates/hydro-domes-guide.png (hydroponics-guide.py, 125 px a cell); ImageGen returned the sheet uniformly at 0.943 of the guide and every piece within a few pixels of its guide, so each rect is its guide frame at that scale. The sheet exported is hydro-domes.amber.png, the raw regraded from magenta to warm amber grow-light by grow-light-amber.py (owner picked amber). Exact prompt in hydro-domes.prompt.txt.
